items.title: Designer Bag Raffle
items.body:
🎁 Win a Designer Bag Valued at $2,000+!
For just $20, you’ll have a chance to win a beautiful designer bag valued at more than $2,000 — while helping us reach our $30,000 fundraising goal!

We’re selling 1,500 tickets at $20 each, with the drawing taking place during our Bingo Night in January 2027.

$20 Ticket • $2,000+ Prize Value • $30,000 Youth Ministry Goal

Your ticket gives you a chance to win while making a meaningful investment in our youth — the future of our church!
